newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks end sharply up on Dow rise.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks end sharply up on Dow rise.

text.p: Jakarta stocks ended higher on Tuesday on active buying of big-caps due to improved sentiment following the Dow's sharp rise on Monday, brokers said.
The Jakarta composite index rose 6.82 points, or 1.04 percent, to close at its high for the day of 659.60 points. Advancers led decliners by 79 to 49 with 76 issues unchanged.
Total turn-over was estimated at 389 around billion rupiah against 354 billion rupiah on Monday.
"A sudden spurt of late buying in shares belonging to the Lippo Group helped the index to make further gains," one broker said.
